telemetry.settings.subtitle: How the minute rollup shares the database with the writers, for the whole installation
telemetry.settings.telemetryRollupDbShar: How much of a database connection the minute rollup may use while it catches up: 5 to 100. After each catch-up step it rests so the writers keep the rest. Lower is gentler on the writers, higher catches up faster.
telemetry.settings.telemetryRollupFullSw: Every how many passes the rollup visits every tenant that ever wrote readings instead of only the recently written ones: 1 to 60 (1 = every pass).
telemetry.settings.telemetryRollupMaxSte: How many rollup steps one pass makes for a tenant and retention class before it moves on: 1 to 120. What is left continues on the next minute. The pass stops after 50 seconds whatever this is.
